description: Inspect live provider evidence before selecting an HTTPS service. Returns the source path, upstream HTTP status and untouched evidence body; unknown evidence stays unknown. Use for provider selection, not as cryptographic certification or proof that a payment settled. This tool does not sign or spend.

target.description: HTTPS provider URL whose live identity, availability and payment evidence should be inspected.

name: verify_provider

body.description: Exact upstream JSON or a bounded text excerpt; missing evidence is not filled in.

ok.description: Whether the selected upstream returned HTTP 2xx; not settlement proof.

title: Verify Provider
